note: Private RV park 5 mi west of Antonito on CO Hwy 17 at the base of Conejos Canyon, ~8,000 ft, in a grove of old cottonwoods; also 8 cabins and tent sites. Directory listings (not the operator) describe back-in and pull-through sites (14 pull-throughs) taking rigs of 40+ ft with slideouts, and nightly rates ~$39-49. A small branch of the Conejos River runs through the property (trout fishing); the RV loop is in an open field away from it. Propane, dog park; near the Cumbres & Toltec railroad. --Claude
summary: Operator site (GoDaddy, phone booking only): confirmed 39 RV sites, full hookups 30/50 A, showers, dump, camp store. Changed season year_round -> closes end of October (opens spring, no date); booking platform phone. Cleared directory-only pull_through. No RV rate is posted anywhere on the operator's site (only cabin rates and '$3 per night' per extra person), so fees stay empty. Note: dropped the year-round claim, the RV Life line and the hookup/amenity restatements.
flags: No posted RV rate: the operator's RV page gives only '$3 per night' per extra person; reservations by phone only. Price indicator is the stored RV Life $$ tier (an earlier private-gap read on 2026-10-02 skipped it for 'price unverifiable'). No gateway within 40 km (nearest Great Sand Dunes NP 91 km); the family has not stayed here. A phone call is the only way to check the US$50 gate.
Presence: operator website with phone 719-376-5710 (matches) and Google Maps 'Twin Rivers Cabins & RV Park', 34044 CO-17, 4.4 stars / 116 reviews. Passes.

Long-stay: monthly rates and 'Store in site ... after 5 consecutive months full hookup rental' are offered, but the park takes nightly reservations and imagery shows the RV loop mostly empty. Not long-stay in character on the evidence.

Re-pin: stored 37.06340,-106.09950 is on CO-17 between this park and Mogote Meadows RV Park (OSM caravan_site at 37.06342,-106.09829, the trailer cluster NE of the highway). Twin Rivers is SW of the highway (OSM 'Twin Rivers Cabins & RV Park' at 37.06301,-106.10033; Google 37.06338,-106.10025); its RV loop with hookup posts is centred about 37.0624,-106.1003 on Esri imagery, ~130 m from the stored pin. Suggest 37.0624,-106.1003.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront): correct. The stream channel through the property ('a small branch of the Conejos River on property') runs along the west side; the RV loop's sites are roughly 60-80 m from it behind a belt of cottonwoods. No lead.
